stories.title: Consent Schema and Data Contract Definition
stories.description: Define MongoDB schema and Pydantic contracts for consent tiers, consent state transitions, audit records, and storage decisions (store vs de-identify vs reject). Ensure compatibility with existing consent_models and debug_logger persistence.

stories.title: Consent Enforcement Middleware in Tool Router
stories.description: Integrate consent checks into tool_router to enforce consent tier before any tool execution that may persist or expose identifiable data. Block or transform requests based on tier (e.g., enforce de-identification for Tier 1).

stories.title: Consent API Write Endpoints
stories.description: Implement FastAPI endpoints to capture initial consent, update consent tier, and record explicit user consent actions. Ensure idempotency and audit logging integration.

stories.title: Consent Workflow Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Create unit tests for consent_service logic (tier transitions, de-identification enforcement) and integration tests covering API, tool_router enforcement, and lead capture interactions.
